targets.rawSql:
WITH ranked AS (
  SELECT
    ir.*,
    row_number() OVER (
      PARTITION BY ir.target, ir.phase
      ORDER BY ir.started_at DESC, ir.id DESC
    ) AS rn
  FROM ingest_runs ir
  WHERE ir.phase_kind = 'target'
    AND (${target:sqlstring} = '' OR ir.target IN (${target:sqlstring}))
)
SELECT
  target,
  phase,
  status,
  started_at,
  completed_at,
  completed_at - started_at AS duration,
  counts,
  notes,
  triggered_by
FROM ranked
WHERE rn = 1
ORDER BY target ASC, phase ASC;

SELECT
  child.id,
  child.parent_run_id,
  parent.target,
  parent.phase AS run_kind,
  child.phase,
  child.phase_kind,
  child.status,
  child.started_at,
  child.completed_at,
  child.completed_at - child.started_at AS duration,
  child.exit_code,
  child.counts,
  child.notes
FROM ingest_runs child
LEFT JOIN ingest_runs parent ON parent.id = child.parent_run_id
WHERE child.started_at >= now() - (${days_back:sqlstring} || ' days')::interval
  AND child.phase_kind <> 'target'
  AND (
    child.status IN ('failed', 'aborted')
    OR (child.status = 'started' AND child.started_at < now() - interval '30 minutes')
  )
  AND (${target:sqlstring} = '' OR parent.target IN (${target:sqlstring}))
ORDER BY child.started_at DESC, child.id DESC;

SELECT
  id,
  source,
  status,
  started_at,
  completed_at,
  completed_at - started_at AS duration,
  seen_count,
  notes
FROM import_runs
WHERE started_at >= now() - (${days_back:sqlstring} || ' days')::interval
  AND (${source:sqlstring} = '' OR source IN (${source:sqlstring}))
ORDER BY started_at DESC, id DESC
LIMIT 200;

SELECT
  'poi' AS row_type,
  p.id,
  p.source,
  p.name,
  p.updated_at,
  p.fetched_at,
  p.deleted_at,
  p.last_seen_run_id,
  p.last_poller_run_id,
  now() - p.updated_at AS updated_age
FROM pois p
WHERE ${source:sqlstring} = '' OR p.source IN (${source:sqlstring})

UNION ALL

SELECT
  'reservable' AS row_type,
  r.id,
  r.source,
  r.type || ':' || r.vendor || ':' || r.vendor_id AS name,
  r.updated_at,
  NULL::timestamptz AS fetched_at,
  r.deleted_at,
  r.last_seen_run_id,
  NULL::bigint AS last_poller_run_id,
  now() - r.updated_at AS updated_age
FROM reservables r
WHERE ${source:sqlstring} = '' OR r.source IN (${source:sqlstring})
ORDER BY updated_age DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 300;

list.name: target
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT target AS __text, target AS __value FROM ingest_runs WHERE target IS NOT NULL ORDER BY target ASC

list.name: source
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT source AS __text, source AS __value FROM (SELECT source FROM pois UNION SELECT source FROM reservables UNION SELECT source FROM import_runs) sources WHERE source IS NOT NULL ORDER BY source ASC
